messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary 'inference-encoder' v3.2 crashlooping in eu-west-1. 503 spike, canary error rate 37%. paging oncall.

oncall-andy: i'm on it — starting triage.

maria: seeing repeated 'Readiness probe failed' then container restarts (5x in ~2m). attaching quick pod log excerpt.

devops-ron: HPA behavior looks odd in the canary manifest — minReplicas=0. that can let k8s scale to 0 during drain windows. could be related.

sre-jen: also noticed a node drain event at ~15:04 UTC in eu-west-1 for maintenance; evictions coincided with the rollout window.

maria: pod log snippet:
```
E0308 15:03:51.123 1 probe.go:45] Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with status code 503
I0308 15:03:51.125 1 kubelet.go:232] Killing container due to unhealthy probe
```

oncall-andy: that readiness 503 lines up with the feature-flag rollout we shipped at 15:02 (ff/inference-redis-caching=true). deploy-bot, confirm?

deploy-bot: rollout recorded: feature-flag ff/inference-redis-caching = true, user=ci-deploy, id=2026-03-08-ff-721, rolled to 10% canary at 15:02:18 UTC.

maria: can we toggle the flag back (kill-switch) and watch behavior?

oncall-andy: initiating flag rollback -> `curl -X POST https://ff-service.internal/toggle -d '{"key":"inference-redis-caching","value":false}'` -> returns 200.

incident-bot: customer impact estimate: ~14 customers saw errors; request success rate dropped to 88% across routed groups (us-east, eu-west). no data exfiltration.

devops-ron: HPA still has minReplicas=0 for canary HPA. propose immediate patch to minReplicas:2 to avoid full teardown during drain windows: `kubectl patch hpa inference-encoder-canary -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`.

sre-jen: applying HPA patch now.

oncall-andy: diverting traffic off canary to minimize impact while we stabilize -> `kubectl annotate svc inference-encoder traffic-weight=0` (manual weight routing).

maria: after flag revert + HPA patch, canary pods stopped crashlooping; readiness went green, restarts ceased. metrics trending back to baseline.

deploy-bot: kill-switch recorded: ff/inference-redis-caching = false (user=oncall-andy, time=15:07 UTC).

oncall-andy: monitoring: error rate down to ~1.2% over 6 minutes. keeping oncall watch.

customer-success-lina: CS notified top-12 affected customers with incident summary and remediation steps; follow-up scheduled.

maria: remediation items (short): increase readinessProbe timeout to 5s (was 1s), add preStop sleep 10s, and change canary HPA minReplicas to 2. also add flag rollout safety check to block if node-drain event in rolling window.

devops-ron: filed PR #4982 with the above changes and HPA template update. tagging eng-runtime and release for priority review.

sre-jen: handing off to eng-oncall for postmortem and long-term mitigations. marking incident P1 and adding paging if recurrence within 24h.

oncall-andy: thanks — staying on watch for 30 more minutes, will close once metrics stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
